steps.en: Install with one command and pick the model that compresses memories
steps.zh: 一条命令安装，选定压缩记忆用的模型

steps.en: Registers lifecycle hooks and starts a local worker service
steps.zh: 注册生命周期钩子，启动本地 worker 服务

steps.en: Work in Claude Code as usual
steps.zh: 照常用 Claude Code 干活

steps.en: Hooks capture your prompts and every tool call in the session
steps.zh: 钩子捕获会话里的消息和每一次工具调用

steps.en: An LLM compresses them into short observations stored locally
steps.zh: 交给 LLM 压缩成简短观察记录，存进本地库

steps.en: Open a new session, or ask about earlier work
steps.zh: 开新会话，或问起以前做过的事

steps.en: Injects relevant summaries; for details, a 3-step search
steps.zh: 自动注入相关摘要；要细节时分三步查

value.en: Project context survives across sessions — no re-explaining every time
value.zh: 跨会话记得项目上下文，不用每次重新交代

sources: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem README Quick Start (npx claude-mem install, provider choice)
